05:00 Problem

By noon, a flat roof is no place to swap a unit.

Rooftop package units sit on black membrane in full sun. Crane lifts, curb seals and electrical all get slower and riskier as the deck heats up.

Fix

Crew on the roof at first light. Old unit craned off, new one set, curb resealed before the heat builds.

Price it: rooftop unit
10:00

After the haboob, the coil needs a rinse, not a replacement.

Problem

The unit runs but the air is barely cool. Dust and cottonwood fluff pack the coil, so the condenser can't shed heat.

Fix

Low-pressure rinse and a soft brush. Most coils come back with water, not a new system. The rinse is part of every monsoon storm check.

Storm check, coil rinse included $129–$219 Sample pricing

14:00 Problem

115° outside. The thermostat says 86° and climbing.

Peak afternoon is when a tired capacitor or a frozen coil gives up. The house heats a degree every few minutes.

Fix

  1. Close the blinds on west windows.
  2. Check the breaker once. If it trips again, leave it.
  3. Set the fan to ON to help a frozen coil thaw.
  4. Never pull the disconnect yourself. Call us.
